$comment: CAO registry — the single source for which adapter serves which CAO (PLAN-v7 D6). IDs from RUNBOOK.md Phase 1 verification (2026-11-05). Agent names: MUSE, Claude CAO, Gemini CAO, AXON CAO. harnessIdentity is the one doorman identity each relay asks with (muse, claude_code, gemini_antigravity, hermes). AXON CAO is the name of the AXON app and bot (Hermes is the harness; v4.0 cutover). Values in <ANGLE_BRACKETS> are placeholders: the relay refuses to start while any placeholder remains. Channel ids and names recorded 2026-11-25 from the live Slack workspace (#cao-bots, #cao-muse, #cao-claude, #cao-gemini, #cao-axon; all public, created 2026-11-20). The axon relay posts to #cao-axon. The slash command /fire-axon-hermes is the name configured in the Slack app and stays until the app is changed.

allowlist.$comment: Authors allowed to start work. Default: the four CAO bot user ids only. JB's id is recorded above for the future membership step and is NOT in the allowlist (Phase 1 exit rule).

caos.home: the AXON CAO chat in Hermes

capsComment: Cost REPORTING numbers only. There are no start caps (daily, monthly, per-CAO weekly): a relay never refuses to start for count or cost. A cost limit is the Token Accountant's job, reported to the CAO.
